sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 384x288, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 25 mK (25 C, F1.0); optical: 1/1.8in CMOS, 4 MP
features: thermal + optical bi-spectrum network positioning system (speed dome)
optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 1/1.8in CMOS, 40x optical zoom (6-240 mm)
additional fixed wide-angle lens overlaid on optical PTZ channel (4 mm, 89.5h x 47.9v)
laser illuminator up to 150 m on the optical channel
temperature measurement -20 to 150 C, accuracy +/-8 C
perimeter protection (line crossing, intrusion, region entrance/exit) via built-in GPU
built-in TPM 2.0 encryption module for cybersecurity
release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD4138-50/G0/T2Y is a thermal/optical bi-spectrum PTZ positioning system with a 384x288 12 um thermal module (50 mm lens, NETD < 25 mK), a 4 MP 40x optical channel plus a fixed wide-angle lens and a 150 m laser illuminator, with TPM 2.0 security.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and optical exposed as separate channels (optical Channel 1, thermal Channel 2).
